# vergeio_tenant_node (Resource)

Gives a tenant a node. `cpu_cores` and `ram` are the capacity of that node. `ram` is megabytes and must be at least 2048. Changing `tenant_id` replaces the node. Destroy gracefully powers off this node when it is running, then kills it if it does not stop in time, then deletes it. Sibling nodes and the parent tenant stay up. VergeOS rejects deleting a node while that node is running.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Give the tenant a node. tenant_id is the key of vergeio_tenant.
# ram is megabytes and must be at least 2048.

resource "vergeio_tenant_node" "example" {
  tenant_id     = vergeio_tenant.example.id
  name          = "node1"
  cpu_cores     = 4
  ram           = 8192
  enabled       = true
  on_power_loss = "last_state"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu_cores` (Number) CPU cores allocated to the node. Minimum 1.
- `ram` (Number) RAM allocated to the node, in megabytes. Minimum 2048.
- `tenant_id` (String) Key of the parent `vergeio_tenant`. Changing it replaces the node.

### Optional

- `cluster` (Number) Target cluster key. Omit to leave the current cluster unchanged.
- `cluster_failover` (Number) Failover cluster key.
- `description` (String) Node description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the tenant node is enabled.
- `ha_group` (String) High-availability group name.
- `name` (String) Node name, unique within the tenant. Omit to let VergeOS assign one.
- `on_power_loss` (String) Behavior when the host loses power: `power_on`, `last_state`, or `leave_off`.
- `preferred_node` (Number) Preferred host node key.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `creator` (String) Username that created the node.
- `id` (String) Tenant node key assigned by VergeOS.
- `is_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether this node record is a snapshot.
- `machine` (Number) Underlying machine row key.
- `modified` (Number) Last modification time as a Unix timestamp.
- `nodeid` (Number) Node identifier within the tenant.

## Import

Import is supported using the tenant node key.

```shell
terraform import vergeio_tenant_node.example <id>
```
